stackback 0.0.2 declares MIT and ships no licence text anywhere this build could measure.

What was measured, in the sitting of 2026-10-18:

- the registry tarball at version 0.0.2 carries a README.md, index.js, formatstack.js, test.js
  and a package.json and no licence file in any shape the staging pass reads
- the repository shtylman/node-stackback at tag v0.0.2 carries no licence entry in its root
- its README carries no licence grant; it ends on install instructions

This file is the tracked record of that measured absence. The pass stages the package's
declaration with no text behind it, which is the row the page already renders honestly. Nothing
here invented a text. If this publisher ever ships one, put the real text at LICENSE beside this
marker and delete the marker, and the next build carries the text.
